title: I paired Gemini with Google Keep and never lost a great idea again
excerpt: Don't underestimate the power of pairing the two
content_html:
Published Aug 3, 2026, 6:00 AM EDT

Although not a juicy tech confession, I have never used more than four note-taking apps in my life. Of these, I took most of my notes on Google Keep because I love how it gets the basics right without compromising on simplicity.

The note-taking app only got better with time, and so did my reliance on it. At this point, it's perhaps the highest, as I never depended on Google Keep this much.

Credit where it's due. I have to give it to Gemini for making me believe that I can't do without Google Keep. I realized it only after I paired Gemini with Google Keep.

While pairing one software with another may sound daunting, I do it quite comfortably, all thanks to Gemini's Google Workspace integration.

As a user, I don't care about the underlying tech that made the pairing possible. The outcome is more important. Ever since I started pairing Gemini with Google Keep, I have never lost a great idea.

Gemini develops my half-baked ideas

I let Gemini think before storing ideas in Google Keep

Like everyone else, I struggled a lot to choose the right color to paint the interior walls. I ultimately took help from Gemini to decide which color would look great in my rooms.

I took a photo of my balcony and was about to type a prompt asking Gemini to show me color options that would make the walls look great. This was the first time I thought, what if my balcony looked like a tiny garden?

I didn't let it escape and instantly put it in Gemini to seek its opinion. I won't share details about what my balcony looks like, but Gemini liked it and instantly suggested what I would need to turn it into a reality.

Gemini wasn't spot on with everything it said, so I wanted it to expand on certain ideas. I also made certain changes and then asked its opinion. It told me what worked and what didn't.

All of this took only about 15 minutes. However, had Gemini not existed, I would've only stored the idea in Google Keep so that I could come back to it later and research online.

I have done it multiple times with other ideas in the past, but I rarely revisited them, or worse, I failed to remember what made them exciting in the first place.

I no longer face this issue, as I instantly put what I feel is worth expanding on using Gemini. Ever since I started using Gemini, I have never had to push a good idea aside for later.

All my chats are available in Gemini so I can revisit and resume the conversation if I want to tweak anything. However, I don't keep my ideas limited to Gemini chats.

I save the best parts of Gemini's answers in Google Keep so that I can find them quickly whenever I need them. This is way better than trying to find that one chat buried in a sea of conversations.

Gemini can store ideas in Google Keep without opening the app

A prompt is all you need

Google Keep isn't connected to Gemini by default, so you need to manually pair them. You need to follow only a few steps to connect Google Keep to Gemini.

To do it, open Settings in Gemini, select Personal Intelligence, click Connected Apps, and enable the Google Workspace toggle. This will connect Gemini to your Google Workspace apps, including Google Keep.

Now, I can type a prompt in Gemini to save its response as a note in Google Keep. You can continue the conversation, and if Gemini spits out more interesting information, you can append the previous note with the additional details.

Not only that, but you can also delete your previous notes right from Gemini.

My Google Keep account stores notes that I created both manually and generated and saved using Gemini. They don't really mix up, as the ones generated by Gemini clearly mention that at the bottom of each note.

However, I use a smarter trick to find all my Gemini-generated notes in Google Keep. Instead of checking the sources, I type "Gemini" in the search box, and it shows all the notes that I generated using Gemini.

On top of this, you can use labels and add background colors to make your Gemini-generated notes stand out from the rest. However, the search bar trick is still the one to beat.

I'll keep using Gemini and Google Keep together

I have been using Gemini and Google Keep together for months, and I don't want to go back.

Still, there are many other apps better than Google Keep, but it's hard to beat the level of convenience Google's note-taking apps offer when paired with Gemini.

For a casual note-taker like me, pairing Gemini with Google Keep is the best way to never let a great idea slip away.

发布于 2026 年 8 月 3 日上午 6:00（美国东部时间）

虽然这不是一个有趣的技术自白，但我一生中从未使用过四个以上的笔记应用程序。 其中，我的大部分笔记都是在 Google Keep 上做的，因为我喜欢它在不影响简单性的情况下正确掌握基础知识。

随着时间的推移，笔记应用程序变得越来越好，我对它的依赖也越来越强。 在这一点上，它可能是最高的，因为我从来没有这么依赖过 Google Keep。

信用应到之处。 我必须把它归功于 Gemini，它让我相信我离不开 Google Keep。 当我将 Gemini 与 Google Keep 配对后我才意识到这一点。

虽然将一个软件与另一个软件配对可能听起来令人畏惧，但我做得相当轻松，这都要归功于 Gemini 的 Google Workspace 集成。

作为用户，我并不关心使配对成为可能的底层技术。 结果更重要。 自从我开始将 Gemini 与 Google Keep 配对以来，我从未失去过一个好主意。

双子座发展了我不成熟的想法

在将想法存储到 Google Keep 之前，我让 Gemini 思考

和其他人一样，我花了很多功夫来选择正确的颜色来粉刷内墙。 我最终在双子座的帮助下决定哪种颜色最适合我的房间。

我拍了一张阳台的照片，正要输入一条提示，要求 Gemini 向我展示能让墙壁看起来很棒的颜色选项。 这是我第一次想到，如果我的阳台看起来像一个小花园怎么办？

我没有让它逃走，立即将它放入双子座征求它的意见。 我不会透露我的阳台是什么样子的细节，但双子座很喜欢它，并立即建议我需要什么才能将它变成现实。

Gemini 并没有完全表达它所说的一切，所以我希望它能够扩展某些想法。 我也做了一些修改，然后询问了它的意见。 它告诉我什么有效，什么无效。

所有这一切只花了大约15分钟。 然而，如果 Gemini 不存在，我只会将这个想法存储在 Google Keep 中，以便稍后我可以回来进行在线研究。

过去我曾多次尝试过其他想法，但我很少重新审视它们，或者更糟糕的是，我记不起最初是什么让它们令人兴奋。

我不再面临这个问题，因为我立即将我认为值得扩展的内容放在使用 Gemini 上。 自从我开始使用 Gemini 以来，我从来没有必要把一个好主意搁置一边。

我的所有聊天内容都可以在 Gemini 中使用，因此如果我想调整任何内容，我可以重新访问并恢复对话。 然而，我的想法并不局限于双子座的聊天。

我将 Gemini 答案中最好的部分保存在 Google Keep 中，以便我在需要时可以快速找到它们。 这比试图在一大堆对话中找到一条聊天记录要好得多。

Gemini 无需打开应用即可将想法存储在 Google Keep 中

您只需要一个提示

默认情况下，Google Keep 未连接到 Gemini，因此您需要手动将它们配对。 您只需执行几个步骤即可将 Google Keep 连接到 Gemini。

为此，请打开 Gemini 中的“设置”，选择“个人智能”，点击“连接的应用程序”，然后启用 Google Workspace 开关。 这会将 Gemini 连接到您的 Google Workspace 应用，包括 Google Keep。

现在，我可以在 Gemini 中输入提示，将其响应保存为 Google Keep 中的注释。 您可以继续对话，如果双子座吐出更多有趣的信息，您可以在之前的注释中添加更多详细信息。

不仅如此，您还可以直接从 Gemini 删除以前的笔记。

我的 Google Keep 帐户存储了我手动创建以及使用 Gemini 生成和保存的笔记。 它们并没有真正混淆，因为 Gemini 生成的那些在每个音符的底部清楚地提到了这一点。

不过，我使用了一个更聪明的技巧来在 Google Keep 中查找所有由 Gemini 生成的笔记。 我没有检查来源，而是在搜索框中输入“Gemini”，它会显示我使用 Gemini 生成的所有笔记。

除此之外，您可以使用标签并添加背景颜色，使 Gemini 生成的笔记脱颖而出。 然而，搜索栏技巧仍然是最难克服的。

我将继续一起使用 Gemini 和 Google Keep

我已经一起使用 Gemini 和 Google Keep 几个月了，我不想再回去了。

尽管如此，还有许多其他应用程序比 Google Keep 更好，但与 Gemini 配合使用时，Google 的笔记应用程序所提供的便利程度是无与伦比的。

对于像我这样的休闲笔记爱好者来说，将 Gemini 与 Google Keep 配对是永远不会让好主意溜走的最佳方式。
